title: State convenor quota vs management quota in affiliated private agriculture colleges
description: Understand how seat allocation, counselling routes and fee structures differ between government convenor seats and management quota seats.
summary: In SAU-affiliated private agriculture colleges across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra, seats are split between state-counselling convenor quotas and institutional management channels—each with different fees and reporting rules.

sections.heading: Same university curriculum, different admission channels and fees
paragraphs: At private colleges affiliated with State Agricultural Universities—such as [Palar Agricultural College](/university/palar-agricultural-college) under TNAU or [SBVR Agricultural College](/university/sbvr-agricultural-college) and [Sri Kinjarapu Yerran Naidu College of Agricultural Sciences](/university/sri-kinjarapu-yerran-naidu-college-of-agricultural-sciences) under ANGRAU—students in the same classroom may have entered through two distinct channels: the state convenor counselling quota or the regulated management quota.
While the syllabus, university examinations and degree certificate come from the affiliating SAU in both channels, the annual tuition fee and admission timeline differ substantially.

sections.heading: Check the quota label on your fee schedule and allotment letter
paragraphs: Before paying any booking or first-semester charge, compare the published convenor and management rates in [applying to TNAU-affiliated private agriculture colleges](/articles/tnau-private-agriculture-college-admission) and [ANGRAU-affiliated private agriculture admission and fee quotas](/articles/angrau-private-agriculture-college-admission). Also review [reading an agriculture fee letter before paying](/blogs/reading-an-agriculture-fee-letter).

faqs.question: Do management-quota students in SAU-affiliated colleges receive the same university degree?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the admission is within the university-sanctioned intake and verified by the affiliating SAU under its management-quota regulations.

faqs.question: Are state government fee-reimbursement schemes applicable to management-quota seats?
faqs.answer: In many states, government tuition reimbursement applies only to convenor-quota seats allotted through state counselling. Confirm eligibility in writing before budgeting.
